structured_output.rationale: 835 denies both lines CO-29 (timely filing expired) with RARC N211. But the 277CA for this exact claim (same TRC75364521) shows STC*A2:20 — accepted into the payer's adjudication system on 2025-01-27, only 8 days after the 2025-01-19 DOS, well inside any plausible filing window. This is a clearinghouse/payer acceptance report, the strongest proof under the timely-filing card, and it contradicts the payer's denial. The remedy is to appeal and dispute the receipt date using that acceptance record, not to write off or refile.

root_cause.explanation: CO-29 denial on both lines despite a 277CA (STC*A2:20) showing the identical claim (TRC75364521) was accepted into the payer's system 2025-01-27, 8 days post-DOS — evidence the claim was in fact filed timely.

next_action.detail: File appeal disputing the CO-29 receipt-date finding; attach the 277CA acceptance report (STC*A2:20, 2025-01-27) as proof of timely submission for DOS 2025-01-19. Do not resubmit as a new/corrected claim.

evidence.fact: CAS*CO*29 on both SVC lines (97110, 97140), MOA*N211
STC*A2:20 accepted for processing 2025-01-27, TRN*2*TRC75364521 matching the 837's BHT TRC
DOS 2025-01-19 (DTP*472), same claim control PA24642236 and TRC75364521

citations.rule: Proof accepted (clearinghouse/payer acceptance report) leads to appeal, dispute the receipt date, don't plead forgiveness
CARC 29: filing limit expired; write off unless proof of timely acceptance exists
